item.title: Trump Is Flipping Out And Demanding That Republicans Rig The Midterm Election
item.description: Donald Trump's gerrymandering effort backfired, so he has moved on to trying to rig the midterm election by trying to get Republicans to pass a massive voter suppression law.

item.title: "Melania" Is Officially A Box Office Bomb And Another Trump Failure
item.description: The box office for what looks like a bribe disguised as a documentary "Melania" withered and died on its second weekend as the film is cementing its box office bomb status.

item.title: Trump's Crash And Burn Has Opened The Door For Democrats To Flip The Senate
item.description: Trump's collapse into total failure on the economy has set up Democrats to do something that looked impossible a year ago. Democrats could flip the Senate.

item.title: Trump Melts Down Over A Canadian Bridge And Says China Will Ban Hockey In Canada
item.description: Donald Trump had a bizarre meltdown where he ranted about the Gordie Howe International Bridge that will connect Detroit and Windsor that twisted into China banning ice hockey and the Stanley Cup.

item.title: Federal Judge Blocks Trump From Getting Michigan's Voter Rolls
item.description: A federal judge in Michigan has blocked the Trump administration from getting access to the voter rolls in the swing state of Michigan.

item.title: A Democratic Congresswoman Delivered A Scathing Moral Rebuke To ICE
item.description: Rep. LaMonica McIver (D-NJ) asked ICE Director Todd Lyons, "How do you think Judgement Day will work for you with so much blood on your hands? Do you think you're going to hell, Mr. Lyons?"

item.title: Trump's Scheme To Steal The Midterm Election Falls Apart
item.description: Trump called on Congress to nationalize the midterm election by passing the SAVE Act, but Senate Majority Leader John Thune said that there aren't enough Republican votes to change the filibuster.

item.title: Pam Bondi Is Having An Epic House Hearing Meltdown
item.description: Attorney General Pam Bondi is trying to sound strong to save her job, but instead, she is coming off like a lunatic having a meltdown at a House Judiciary Committee Oversight hearing.

item.title: Trump Is Spying On Congress As They Read The Unredacted Epstein Files
item.description: A photo taken during AG Pam Bondi's House testimony is evidence that the Trump administration is spying on members of Congress as they read the unredacted Epstein files.

item.title: Trump Shows That He Is Now In Worse Decline Than Joe Biden Ever Was
item.description: Donald Trump seemed to forget where he was and the name of the made-up clean coal award that he was getting at the White House, as Trump now seems more feeble than Biden ever was.
